title: the crossing judges in codemother's process read the inspector's launch roots
intention: crossing_proof_named resolves the journals it judges through the inspector's launch-bendable _crossing_roots(), so a fixture world a proof stands behind CodeMother's launch reaches it.
why: Since 17d570c10390 the crossing judges run in CodeMother's process, and a proof can stand a fixture world behind them only by her launch environment. crossing_proof_named called crossings.proven_by_since_buildme(ticket) with no roots and crossing_fixme resolved the ticket by _tf.find_ticket, so each read the live world: base's proofs test_a_dead_proof_name_is_refused_at_proveme (red ticket d3248e7cb2fd) and test_a_fixme_answer_binds_to_its_kick_back (red ticket 2517060264b4) read red. Both fixes are inspector.py hunks; under RULE 1 they are this build_inspector child, and the two base tickets keep only their base proofs.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass: a judge that reads the live world while its proof stands a fixture world proves nothing) and RULE 1 (a ticket's build lives inside its own component).
how: D1: in inspector.py, crossing_proof_named passes _crossing_roots() to crossings.proven_by_since_buildme, and crossing_fixme resolves its ticket with ticket_path(ticket, root=_TICKETS_ROOT); both as built at d5ca3c7ae and df8bc9f8c. D2: one red-first proof in build_inspector/proofs/, re-homing d5ca3c7ae's in-process tooth (cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_proof_named_judge_reads_the_crossing_roots.py, which tests the inspector and so belongs here) and adding a crossing_fixme tooth that stands a fixture ticket corpus behind _TICKETS_ROOT; it calls the judges in this process, no bus. AMENDED 2026-11-14: clause 2 (crossing_fixme under _TICKETS_ROOT) retired; crossing_fixme already reads the launch through 3e08's ticket_store bend of _tf._TICKETS.

clauses.claim: crossing_proof_named, with a fixture world stood behind inspector._crossing_roots that holds a BUILDME crossing and a since-named dead proof, reads that world: the dead name is in the union it judges and the live journals are not read

decisions.text: D1: crossing_proof_named passes _crossing_roots() to crossings.proven_by_since_buildme. crossing_fixme stays on _tf.find_ticket: 3e08's ticket_store launch (on main) bends _tf._TICKETS, which find_ticket reads, so a _TICKETS_ROOT hunk would bypass it.

D2: one red-first proof, cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_the_crossing_judges_read_the_launch_roots.py, one tooth for clause 1, calling crossing_proof_named in this process with the fixture world stood behind inspector._crossing_roots; it replaces the base-homed copy d5ca3c7ae added.
